title: Decision-tree depth under coordinate reindexing
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to the signs, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs outside $J$. The decision-tree depth of the binary function obtained by restricting $f$ to those fixed signs equals the decision-tree depth of the corresponding reindexed restriction, viewed as a function on the binary cube with $|J|$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
A sign assignment on the complement of $J$
